method: Human visual inspection through view_image of these six exact final production captures; no claim of reviewing all captured PNG.
observations: Desktop stats shows the actual completion trend and actionable no-deadline total; a transient Undo toast partly overlaps the lower frame.
Chinese dark settings shows theme-card layers and scrollable category navigation; a completion toast generated before the language switch still carries its earlier English text.
Firefox final desktop reload shows the active undated task and 1/2 completed retained.
Firefox narrow editor shows pending child text and accessible footer save action in a scrolled modal.
WebKit desktop timeline separates dated/completed and undated work.
WebKit narrow calendar capture is vertically scrolled with a sticky translucent toolbar and transient Undo toast; it is not a full-page unobstructed calendar image.
ui_defect_claim: No new critical visual blocker identified in these selected captures; this does not replace physical-device review or the earlier broad product audit.
